deferred: Owned WM_IME_START/END messages exercise only application guards; they do not establish OS Korean IME/TSF correctness. The renderer hook is synthetic: physical keyboard/focus/IME and WebView/OS accelerator routing, per-monitor DPI, accessibility and composed visual acceptance are not established. PNG artifacts include native EDIT client paint but exclude nonclient titlebar pixels.
